related.title: 三哩島二號機事故後清理工程
related.titleEn: Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup
related.transfer: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「廠址解除管制的標準」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "The standard for releasing a site" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國首座完整除役的商用規模反應爐：壓力槽整體移除、萬里駁運與成本；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程則以爐心熔毀後的十四年：除污、水下取出燃料殘骸、鐵路運送與事故水的蒸發為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first commercial-scale reactor fully decommissioned in the United States: one-piece vessel removal, a long barge voyage and cost; Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup centres on fourteen years after a core melt: decontamination, underwater removal of fuel debris, rail shipment and evaporation of accident water, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓力槽的整件移除」與「半衰期與活度衰減」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的模型移到三哩島二號機事故後清理工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「探查爐心的空洞」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Removing the vessel in one piece" and "Half-life and decay of activity".
Move the model of "Shield thickness and half-value layers" to Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Exploring the void in the core", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「廠址解除管制的標準」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "The standard for releasing a site" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup must be respecified.

related.title: 國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「廠址解除管制的標準」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "The standard for releasing a site" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國首座完整除役的商用規模反應爐：壓力槽整體移除、萬里駁運與成本；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程則以BWR-6 與馬克三型圍阻體：抑壓池、用過燃料池容量、乾式貯存與二十五年除役為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first commercial-scale reactor fully decommissioned in the United States: one-piece vessel removal, a long barge voyage and cost; Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning centres on BWR-6 with Mark III containment: suppression pool, spent-fuel pool capacity, dry storage and a twenty-five-year decommissioning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓力槽的整件移除」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的模型移到國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「乾式貯存護箱的數量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Removing the vessel in one piece" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Shield thickness and half-value layers" to Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The number of dry-storage casks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「廠址解除管制的標準」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "The standard for releasing a site" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 希平港核電廠除役工程
history.text: 1957 年機組併網發電；1982 年永久停機；1985 年除役工程開始；1988 年壓力槽整件吊出並啟運；1989 年除役完成。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1957: The unit was connected to the grid. 1982: Permanent shutdown. 1985: Decommissioning began. 1988: The vessel package was lifted out and shipped. 1989: Decommissioning was completed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
